geographySources.title: State and union territory capitals: administrative and legislative roles
geographySources.summary: Reference inventory of 28 states and eight union territories, administrative capitals and seasonal legislative centres. Used for navigation coverage; specific corrections are bound separately.
geographySources.locator: States and Union territories tables; introductory administrative-capital note
limitations: Secondary, changeable compilation; not a legal notification.
The fetched table retains Port Blair; the primary 2024 renaming source supersedes that label.
Two-decimal city coordinates are manually curated approximate navigation anchors, not validated sites of incidents, offices, people or payments.

geographySources.title: Government renames Port Blair as Sri Vijaya Puram
geographySources.summary: Official announcement renames the Andaman and Nicobar Islands capital Sri Vijaya Puram.
limitations: Name correction only; not evidence of funding or a case.

coverageMeaning: A navigation and acquisition plan covering capitals for all36state/UT jurisdictions, seasonal centres and selected metro/project cities. Case counts are derived from actual research; unresearched is not low risk.
sectorMeaning: Planned sector checklist per city; does not assert cases have been investigated in every sector.
